guide.title: Sticker Prompt Guide
guide.intro: Helps you write AI prompts — for ChatGPT, Gemini and similar tools — that keep the character consistent and are easier to split and de-background afterwards.

character.title: Step 1: Define the character
character.body: Decide the character type, age feel, hairstyle, outfit, main and accent colors, body proportions, personality, and any fixed props. Generate and confirm a single reference image first, then generate the whole set of expressions from that same reference — don't generate dozens of expressions right away.

style.title: Step 2: Pick a drawing style
style.body: Choose one style from the soft, simple, cute, or other word groups and keep it consistent across the whole set.
style.tip: Complex watercolor, translucent shadows, and soft hair edges are harder to remove backgrounds from. Simple line art, flat outlines, and a clean white border are much easier to split.

mood.title: Step 3: Pick moods and actions
mood.body: Check the moods you want from the word library — these words can also be reused as export file names. The default prompt requires no text anywhere in the image.

composition.title: Step 4: Composition rules
composition.body: A single sticker per generation gives a bigger character, sharper detail, and is easier to de-background, but needs more generations. A regular grid (2×2/2×4/3×3/4×4) produces many stickers at once, but the prompt must require exactly one complete character per cell, no overlap, no cropping, and no divider lines.

outlineBg.title: Step 5: White outline & background
outlineBg.body: A white or high-contrast sticker outline clarifies the subject boundary and merges small decorations with the character into one piece, which makes automated splitting easier. Generate against a solid mid-tone background and let this site turn it into true transparency during background removal.

outline.title: Preconditions for outlines to help splitting
items: The outline must be fully closed
Every element must sit inside the outline
The background color outside the outline must clearly differ from the outline itself
Different stickers must never be connected through their outlines
There must be enough space between stickers

background.title: Recommended background colors
items: Any soft but uniform solid color
background.warning: Avoid near-white backgrounds — the white outline and the background become hard to separate.
